nodes.label: SEFSTARS Record Format (names, ICRS position, proper motion, parallax, magnitude)
nodes.rationale: Each fixed-star record holds traditional name, nomenclature name, equinox (1950/2000/ICRS), RA h/m/s, Dec d/m/s, proper motion (RA in 0.001"/yr * cos(decl0), Dec in 0.001"/yr), radial velocity, annual parallax (0.001"), V magnitude, and obsolete DM zone/number fields. Data based on S. Moshier, updated from SIMBAD; preferred stars may be moved to the top of the file to speed up swe_fixstar().
